headline: Escalating Iran War Chokes Off Global Helium Supply, Threatening AI and Semiconductor Production Within Weeks
summary: An intensifying conflict in the Middle East, marked by kinetic strikes on oil tankers and aggressive geopolitical threats, is severely disrupting critical supply chains. This immediately jeopardizes the global helium supply, a vital resource for AI infrastructure and semiconductor manufacturing, with critical shortages anticipated in less than two months.

headline: Iran War Sparks Critical Helium Shortage, Threatening AI Chip Production within 48 Days.
